view.scene_description: A wide-angle view of a large warehouse aisle flanked by tall metal shelving units packed with red plastic crates. An orange forklift is parked on the right near wooden pallets. The concrete floor extends into the distance toward a brightly lit doorway at the far end. Overhead lighting illuminates the space, revealing industrial equipment and orderly storage.

objects.label: warehouse shelving
objects.observation: Tall, multi-tiered metal shelves line both sides of the aisle, filled with red plastic crates. On the left, shelves extend from the foreground to mid-frame. On the right, shelves recede into the background, converging toward a distant doorway. Crates are stacked neatly, some labeled 'HYDAC'.

objects.label: red plastic crates
objects.observation: Numerous red plastic crates are stacked on shelves. Some are labeled 'HYDAC' and 'LOAD'. They appear uniform in size and shape, arranged in rows. Crates are visible on both left and right shelves, with some partially obscured by other items or shadows.

objects.label: orange forklift
objects.observation: An orange forklift is parked on the right side of the aisle, near wooden pallets. Its black steering column and seat are visible. It faces away from the camera, positioned close to the foreground. The forklift's forks are down, resting on the floor.

objects.label: wooden pallets
objects.observation: Several wooden pallets are stacked near the forklift on the right. One holds a large wooden crate secured with straps. Another pallet lies empty nearby. They sit directly on the concrete floor, aligned parallel to the aisle.

objects.label: concrete floor
objects.observation: The floor is smooth, gray concrete extending throughout the entire frame. It reflects overhead lights, creating subtle highlights. The floor is clear of debris, providing a clean path between the shelves and around the forklift.

objects.label: yellow and black striped safety cone
objects.observation: A yellow and black striped safety cone is placed on the left side near the base of the shelving unit. It stands upright on the concrete floor, likely marking an area or obstacle. Its bright colors contrast with the surrounding red and gray tones.

objects.label: doorway
objects.observation: A brightly lit doorway is visible at the far end of the aisle, centered in the background. It emits strong white light, contrasting with the dimmer warehouse interior. The doorway appears rectangular and framed by walls.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "loco-s1-33088", "image_size": [640, 480], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
